+# ProEtaleSectionModuleFunctors proof elaboration and chosen mate proofs
+
+## Reason
+
+The source contains three named holes. Their proofs reuse the existing normalized
+ringed pushforward theorem, the fixed section equivalences and adjunction comparisons,
+the monoidal adjunction transport theorem, and Mathlib PullbackFree. The original
+internal projection calculation causes unnecessary expansion of large coefficient
+terms; it is replaced by the already proved lower_mu_pi API. All public signatures,
+public imports, operations and pure-tensor predicates retain their original meaning.
+The private canonical pairing is identified with its original construction by the
+existing condensedUpperStarMonoidal_eq theorem.
+
+## Old
+
+```lean
+private noncomputable def canonicalInternalPush {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
+    (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ f).LaxMonoidal := by
+  letI : (CondensedRing.upperStar Λ f).OplaxMonoidal :=
+    (CondensedRing.monoidal_upperStar Λ f).toOplaxMonoidal
+  exact (CondensedRing.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction Λ f).rightAdjointLaxMonoidal
+```
+
+The two public strong instances used Functor.Monoidal.ofOplaxMonoidal directly,
+with their already declared invertibility instances supplied by instance search.
+The two ordinary comparison existence proofs extracted the large comparison bundle.
+
+## New
+
+```lean
+private noncomputable def canonicalInternalPush {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
+    (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ f).LaxMonoidal := by
+  letI : (CondensedRing.upperStar Λ f).OplaxMonoidal :=
+    (CondensedRing.condensedUpperStarMonoidal Λ f).toOplaxMonoidal
+  exact (CondensedRing.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction Λ f).rightAdjointLaxMonoidal
+```
+
+The proved equality condensedUpperStarMonoidal_eq identifies these two terms.
+Both strong instances explicitly bind exactly their existing named unit and tensor
+invertibility proofs before calling the same ofOplaxMonoidal expression. Their
+maps and inverse choices are unchanged (the changed arguments are propositions).
+The ordinary tensor/unit/total existence proofs use the same already proved private
+comparison API directly, avoiding expansion of a large existential bundle.
+All additional helpers are private and proved. Local instance priorities and
+transparency settings affect only elaboration in this file. No target meaning
+changes and no consumer requires an adaptation.
+
+## Users
+
+The downstream list was computed with tools/downstream.py and its --uses scan for
+internalPullMonoidal and pullMonoidal. The only downstream textual uses of those
+names are SectionDerivedTensorNormalization, RestrictedCoefficientMateProjection,
+and IntegralQuotientDirectImageComparison; their conversion to the unchanged oplax
+maps and instance suppression remain valid. Every other row is a transitive import.

+# ProEtaleSectionModuleFunctors proof-local canonical pairing
+
+## Reason
+
+Prove the normalized section pushforward and the specified section pullback unit.
+Avoid unfolding the large internal tensor and scalar-extension constructions by
+reusing the existing proved APIs. The private internal canonical pairing is
+expressed through a named strong instance already proved equal to the original.
+No theorem statement or module operation changes. The normalization predicate
+is expressed by the existing general predicate with the same pointwise formula.
+
+## Old
+
+```lean
+  letI : (CondensedRing.upperStar Λ f).OplaxMonoidal :=
+    (CondensedRing.monoidal_upperStar Λ f).toOplaxMonoidal
+  exact (CondensedRing.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction Λ f).rightAdjointLaxMonoidal
+```
+
+The public strong instances directly called `Functor.Monoidal.ofOplaxMonoidal`
+with the global component invertibility instances.
+
+## New
+
+```lean
+  letI : (CondensedRing.upperStar Λ f).OplaxMonoidal :=
+    (CondensedRing.condensedUpperStarMonoidal Λ f).toOplaxMonoidal
+  exact (CondensedRing.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction Λ f).rightAdjointLaxMonoidal
+```
+
+`canonicalInternalPull_eq` uses the lax/oplax round trip directly on this named
+strong structure; the internal component proofs use that same named structure.
+The existing theorem `condensedUpperStarMonoidal_eq` proves it equal to the old
+expanded structure. Thus the canonical pairing and all chosen mate maps retain
+their meaning. The strong instances locally name their existing
+component invertibility instances before the same strong conversion. No data or
+inverse changes. The proof-only imports expose existing private comparison APIs;
+local reducibility and instance priority settings do not affect consumers.
+All public theorem signatures and attributes are unchanged. The normalization
+predicate and its added public import are recorded below. The source
+library is untouched. This repeats the proof context described in the already
+landed A9-section-module-proof-context record, absent from the current item file.

+| all public importers | unchanged | identical public signatures and operations; no forced adaptations |

+## Normalization predicate
+
+Old definition:
+
+```lean
+def PushNormalized {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
+    (m : (pushforward Λ f).LaxMonoidal) : Prop :=
+  ∀ (M N : modules Λ X) (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
+    (x : ((pushforward Λ f).obj M).val.obj U)
+    (y : ((pushforward Λ f).obj N).val.obj U),
+    ((m.μ M N).val.app U)
+        (sectionPureTensor Λ Y _ _ U x y) =
+      sectionPureTensor Λ X M N
+          ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @WeaklyEtale ⊤ f).op.obj U) x y
+
+```
+
+New definition:
+
+```lean
+def PushNormalized {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
+    (m : (pushforward Λ f).LaxMonoidal) : Prop :=
+  SheafOfModules.RingedPushforwardPureTensor (InternalModuleOperations.siteMap f)
+    (ring Λ Y) (ring Λ X) (coefficientMap Λ f) m
+
+```
+
+The two formulas use the same sheafification tensor map, base-changed site
+object, and coefficient restriction. `RingedDirectImagePairingLax` is now a
+public import because its predicate occurs in this definition. The public
+theorem signatures stay unchanged. Consumer search found no external use of
+this predicate: the unqualified `PushNormalized` in
